description:
Search notes and logs and summarise thread activity. Returns absolute paths plus metadata, never file bodies. Open results with notes cat or a file reader.

Subcommands:
  notes [--thread THREAD] [--type TYPE] [--text TEXT] [--since DATE] [--until DATE] [--limit N] [--json] — find notes
  logs [--thread THREAD] [--text TEXT] [--since DATE] [--until DATE] [--limit N] [--json] — find daily logs
  activity [--thread THREAD] [--since DATE] [--until DATE] [--json] — rank threads by activity (notes, logs, hours) in a window
  overview THREAD [--since DATE] [--until DATE] [--limit N] [--json] — the whole picture of one thread
  stream [--thread THREAD] [--kind KINDS] [--text TEXT] [--today] [--reverse] [--since DATE] [--until DATE] [--limit N] [--json] — every dated record in one chronology

Flags:
  common:
    --thread THREAD  thread name, 'Kind/Name' or wikilink
    --since DATE     on or after YYYY-MM-DD
    --until DATE     on or before YYYY-MM-DD
    --json           JSON output
  notes:
    --type TYPE  note type, e.g. Meeting; case-insensitive
    --text TEXT  case-insensitive literal match on topic and body
    --limit N    max results (default 20; 0 = all)
  logs:
    --text TEXT  case-insensitive literal match on entry lines
    --limit N    default 20; 0 = all
  overview:
    --limit N    recent items listed (default 5; 0 = all)
  stream:
    --kind KINDS  comma-separated from: note, log, task, done, hours, payment, thread, person, pending (default: all)
    --text TEXT   case-insensitive literal match on thread and summary
    --today       shorthand for --since and --until set to today
    --reverse     oldest first (default: newest first)
    --limit N     max events (default 100; 0 = all)

Examples:
  ["notes", "--thread", "Projects/Northwind", "--type", "Meeting", "--json"]
  ["logs", "--text", "invoice", "--since", "2026-09-01"]
  ["overview", "Projects/Northwind", "--json"]
  ["stream", "--today", "--kind", "task,done,hours"]

Notes:
  Dates are event dates (a note's frontmatter timestamp), not capture dates.
  Hours descriptions are not searched by text.
  Files that are not valid UTF-8 are skipped; lint reports them.
  Exit 1: unknown value in --kind.
